'''Michael Pistone The Ultimate Profit Deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Michael Pistone]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10118">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10118 The Ultimate Profit Deck], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 2 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10118/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10118/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018124519/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10118/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Michael Pistone]]
* '''Published:''' 2 September 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''The Ultimate Profit Deck''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Profit Pistone LS 2000 10118.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' A profit deck that causes mad nasty drain damage and has lots of retrieval with mad activation.

== Original post ==

'''The Ultimate Profit Deck'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone
* '''Published:''' September 2, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' A profit deck that causes mad nasty drain damage and has lots of retrieval with mad activation.

=== Strategy ===

Your basic profit deck, except i use alien han and keep him at the audience chamber so he can't be battled or die.  and you force drain with eloms with tessek, cancel drains with bargaining table, and give profit damage with mains.  If they stay at the audience chamber and won't move put out order to engage and they'll move fast.  keep han at the ac and everything will work out fine.
